Name: GRASS_TYPE_PARAM_ST
Description: Dynamic instanced assets, combined with a flat or billboard texture. Used to generate scattered grass or other such arrangements without the need for manual placement.

Fields.Name: LOD 0: Cluster Type
Fields.Description: What is drawn at LOD 0 (nearest): none, model, billboard, flat planes or simple model.

Fields.Name: LOD 1: Cluster Type
Fields.Description: What is drawn at LOD 1.

Fields.Name: LOD 2: Cluster Type
Fields.Description: What is drawn at LOD 2 (farthest). 0: nothing is drawn at this distance.

Fields.Name: Base Density
Fields.Description: Base placement density of the instances, multiplied by the grass weight painted on the ground.

Fields.Name: Model Name
Fields.Description: Name of the model placed for this grass type.

Fields.Name: Flat Texture Name
Fields.Description: Texture used by the flat planes (flat cluster type). Leave empty when unused.

Fields.Name: Billboard Texture Name
Fields.Description: Texture used by the billboard (billboard cluster type). Leave empty when unused.

Fields.Name: Effect of Tilt %
Fields.Description: Percentage of how much each instance tilts to follow the ground's surface normal. 0 keeps it upright.

Fields.Name: Maximum Tilt Angle
Fields.Description: Maximum tilt of an instance from upright. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Tilt Angle Jitter
Fields.Description: Random extra tilt applied to each instance. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Width Scale: Minimum
Fields.Description: Minimum of the random width scale. In percent (100 = model size).

Fields.Name: Width Scale: Maximum
Fields.Description: Maximum of the random width scale. In percent (100 = model size).

Fields.Name: Height Scale: Minimum
Fields.Description: Minimum of the random height scale. In percent (100 = model size).

Fields.Name: Height Scale: Maximum
Fields.Description: Maximum of the random height scale. In percent (100 = model size).

Fields.Name: 1: Multiplication Color: R
Fields.Description: Red of multiplication colour 1, as a 0-255 multiplier (255 = no tint).

Fields.Name: 1: Multiplication Color: G
Fields.Description: Green of multiplication colour 1, as a 0-255 multiplier (255 = no tint).

Fields.Name: 1: Multiplication Color: B
Fields.Description: Blue of multiplication colour 1, as a 0-255 multiplier (255 = no tint).

Fields.Name: 2: Multiplication Color: R
Fields.Description: Red of multiplication colour 2, as a 0-255 multiplier (255 = no tint).

Fields.Name: 2: Multiplication Color: G
Fields.Description: Green of multiplication colour 2, as a 0-255 multiplier (255 = no tint).

Fields.Name: 2: Multiplication Color: B
Fields.Description: Blue of multiplication colour 2, as a 0-255 multiplier (255 = no tint).

Fields.Name: Flat Texture: Plane Separation
Fields.Description: How the flat planes are spread: evenly over 180 degrees (Half) or 360 degrees (Full).

Fields.Name: Flat Texture: Number of Planes
Fields.Description: Number of flat planes.

Fields.Name: Flat Texture: Plane Angle
Fields.Description: Lean of the flat planes. In degrees (negative leans the other way).

Fields.Name: Flat Texture: Plane Distance
Fields.Description: Offset of the flat planes from the centre of the instance.

Fields.Name: Cast Shadow
Fields.Description: Whether this grass asset will cast a shadow.

Fields.Name: Wind Amplitude
Fields.Description: Strength of the wind sway. 0 disables the sway.

Fields.Name: Use Dummy Polygon Direction
Fields.Description: If ON, the plane angle follows the dummy poly direction: the dummy poly's acute-angle direction is treated as the front.

Fields.Name: Wind Speed
Fields.Description: Cycle (speed) of the wind sway.

Fields.Name: Orientation Direction
Fields.Description: Facing of each instance. In degrees. -1: random facing.

Fields.Name: Orientation Range of Direction
Fields.Description: Range either side of the Orientation Direction that the facing may vary. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Simple Model Name
Fields.Description: Low-detail model used by the simple model cluster type. Leave empty when unused.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD Range ID
Fields.Description: The grass LOD range parameter to use for this grass asset.

Fields.Name: Particle ID
Fields.Description: Particle effect generated when the cluster type is Model and SFX.
